extracted.name: Creamy Parmesan Polenta
extracted.description: Creamy polenta is easy to make when starting with packaged polenta, chicken broth, and Parmesan cheese. It's a delicious side, starter, or base for stew.
ingredient_lines: 1 (18 ounce) package polenta, cut into 1/2-inch cubes
instruction_lines: Combine polenta and chicken broth in a saucepan over medium heat. Cook, stirring continuously, until polenta has broken down completely in broth, about 5 minutes.
Remove from the heat. Stir in Parmesan cheese, pepper, and paprika.
